class.name: FileSystemDatabase
class.brief_description: A [NetwDatabaseBackend] that keeps records in files under one directory.
class.description: Records outlive the process, so this is the backend a shipped single player or listen server game saves into. [codeblock] var backend := FileSystemDatabase.new() backend.root = "user://saves" Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves").backend(backend) [/codeblock] Each slot is a directory under [member root], and each record is one file inside it. A record is replaced by writing a new file beside it and renaming over the target. A file this library did not write is reported as present and refused as unrecognized. It is never read as an empty save and it is never overwritten by the read that found it. [b]Record errors[/b] The connection [method _open] answers reports these. A scan never fails on its own, and a record file it cannot open fails the page as unrecognized. [codeblock lang=text] _read the read reply's error ┠╴OK the file was read, or there is no file ┖╴ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN the record file exists and could not be opened _write_batch one Error per operation ┠╴OK the file was replaced or removed, or there was none to remove ┠╴ERR_CANT_CREATE the directory for the record could not be created ┠╴ERR_FILE_CANT_WRITE the new file could not be opened for writing ┖╴FAILED renaming over the record, or removing it, failed [/codeblock]

method.name: _delete_slot
method.description: Removes the directory for [param slot] and every record inside it. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK slot was absent or was removed ┠╴ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN slot could not be opened ┠╴ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION the process cannot remove the slot ┖╴ERR_FILE_CANT_WRITE removing the slot failed [/codeblock]

method.name: _list_slots
method.description: Reads [member root] and resolves every slot directory it contains. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK root was read and slots were listed ┠╴ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN root could not be opened ┠╴ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION the process cannot read root ┖╴ERR_FILE_CANT_READ reading root failed [/codeblock]

method.name: _open
method.description: Opens [param slot] and resolves a fresh [NetwDatabaseConnection] rooted at its directory. The connection performs all record I/O for the slot. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK slot was opened ┠╴ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN the slot could not be opened ┠╴ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION the process cannot open the slot ┖╴ERR_FILE_CANT_READ reading the slot failed [/codeblock]

members.member: The directory every slot lives under. A path under [code]user://[/code] is the one a shipped game can write to on every platform.
